newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST-Perstorp pretax seen 220 mln sk.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Perstorp pretax seen 220 mln sk.

text.p: Swedish chemical group Perstorp AB is expected to show a pretax profit of 220 million crowns for the period September-December, a Reuters poll of five analysts showed.
The period makes up the first four months of its financial year 1996/1997.
The forecasts ranged from 200 million crowns to 255 million.
During the corresponding year-earlier period, Perstorp posted a pretax profit of 225 million crowns.
For the full year financial year 1996/1997, analysts expect a pretax profit of 755 million crowns, up from 716 million in 1995/1996.
Perstorp has previously forecast a full financial year pretax profit around the same levels as in the year-earlier period.
The company will release its earnings later on Friday. PRETAX PROFIT (millions)
Sources: Handelsbanken, Matteus, Nordiska, Swedbank, Morgan Grenfell.
